method: Fresh Chromium contexts; one post-handoff scene observation, not earliest readable paint. World-space configured card-to-takeoff traces include shared overflow roles. Viewport proxy additionally requires fully contained titles and curve control hull, ink on both layers and no sampled nonendpoint body crossings. Neither endpoint matching nor sampled ink proves individual pixel legibility.

limitations: Large handoff observations and matched 102-wire observations are separate; large-settled supplies full request parity for 104 nodes only.
Layer backing ink is not a compositor/physical display measurement and cannot identify a single binding at a shared takeoff.
Hidden paths are sampled geometry, 32 points per cubic against non-endpoint card bodies; intersections can be missed. No z-buffer coverage claim.
Synthetic fixture and delays do not represent a live Nodel server. No live host, external origin or full product build.
